outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution maps are heatmap-style overlays on tissue images showing cell-type fraction per spot; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Box plots are exempt from this check by default, but here individual data points (dots for each biological replicate/spot) are additionally overlaid on the box plots for all four immune cell populations.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Bar graph of log2 fold-change per gene derived from DEG analysis is shown as single bars with only p-values annotated; no individual data points (e.g., per-spot/per-sample values) are overlaid, and this plot type is not on the exemption list.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
